comment: The captured modules this oracle runs against, pinned by SHA-256. They are not
vendored: WhatsApp ships them, and a copy inside this repository would drift
from the capture the protocol notes refer to. scripts/fetch-wasm.py reads this
file, fetches each module from the origin CDN url recorded with it, falls
back to the release archives named below, and refuses any payload whose
bytes do not match.
The origin url is where the capture was taken from, and WhatsApp's CDN still
serves these exact bytes long after the rollout that produced them has moved
on — every hash below verifies against it. It needs no token, which the
release archives do, so it is tried first. The path segment after rsrc.php is
part of the address and not decoration: the same file under a different one
is a 403.
Pinned by hash rather than tracking the latest capture, because every function
index, table slot and absolute address in README.md, VOIP_STATUS.md and the
tests was read out of these exact bytes. WhatsApp renames these files on each
rollout and the module behind a given name stays the same *program* — but not
the same *binary*: functions are renumbered and data moves. Swapping one in
silently invalidates every recorded offset, so replacing a module is a
re-derivation, never an update. See 'Following a capture forward' in README.md.
The VoIP engine was moved from D5pLH9sfOOl (9,794,866 B) to JgwtTQVeWPm
(10,650,934 B) so that this oracle and the unwasm decompiler read the same
bytes; a function index carried between them means nothing otherwise. It is
no longer in whatspec's current set — that has rolled on to S_ivh1PriOA — so
the CDN url above is the source that still serves it, verified to these
bytes. The indices re-derived for it are recorded next to each use.

D5pLH9sfOOl is the *previous* VoIP capture, kept pinned rather than dropped. It is what makes `oracle carry` testable: carrying an index between two rollouts cannot be checked with one rollout on disk, and a test that skips for want of a file reports success while proving nothing. It is also the capture every note in VOIP_STATUS.md older than the bump was measured on.
